newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht slightly weaker late, interbank steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht slightly weaker late, interbank steady.

text.p: The Thai baht was slightly weaker in quiet trade late on Monday with the currency tracking the narrower trade in dollar/yen, dealers said.
The bid/offer range of dollar/baht baht was being quoted at 25.799-25.807 per dollar against 25.797-25.807 earlier, traders said.

"There were some bids from local banks in the afternoon which put the baht on the right side, about 1.5 satang higher than the mid-rate, but trade was very quiet with very little news," said a dealer at Siam Commercial Bank.
The Bank of Thailand set the mid-rate at 25.78 baht per dollar.
Traders said baht/dollar trading was quiet as the dollar struggled to make further gains against the yen above 119.
The market was expected to be more active on Tuesday in anticipation of a further strengthening dollar, they said.
The one month baht/dollar swap premium bid/offer was quoted at 8.90/9.40 satang.
The interbank rate was steady at 10.00-10.50 percent, with the market similarly quiet on a lack of news or incentives, dealers said. --James Mclean (662) 652-0642
